title: Define sizing semantics for amplified symbols
description:
Amplifiers substantially change the symbol extent: a land unit grows from 158 x 135.5 bare to 363 x 239.5 with uniqueDesignation + direction + speed.

Today getDimensions() passes min(width,height) to milsymbol as 'size' and then sharp fits the SVG to width x height. With amplifiers active, 'size' scales the frame while the amplifier text extends well past it, so a caller asking for a 500px PNG gets a much smaller frame surrounded by text.

Decide and document what size/width/height mean for an amplified symbol: bare frame size, full amplified extent, or a new parameter to choose. Blocks a clean amplifier release.
acceptance_criteria: Documented rule in README; raster output for an amplified symbol matches the requested dimensions predictably.

title: Kinematics: direction-of-movement leader, speed, altitude/depth
description:
Render track kinematics on the symbol and carry them into 3D.

milsymbol renders a movement leader line when 'direction' (degrees) is set, with 'speedLeader' controlling leader length. Verified: a land unit with direction+speed+speedLeader goes from 595 bytes / 0 text nodes to 1014 bytes / 2 text nodes / 3 line-path elements.

Scope:
- direction (degrees) and speedLeader on all 2D formats
- speed and altitudeDepth amplifiers
- feed the existing 3D 'heading' parameter from 'direction' so an extruded symbol faces its direction of travel

Note that adding kinematics grows the symbol bounding box (land unit: 158x135.5 bare -> 363x239.5 with designation+direction+speed), so sizing semantics must be settled alongside atak-sidc-server-mqd.
acceptance_criteria: direction/speedLeader/speed/altitudeDepth settable via query string; 3D heading defaults from direction when not explicitly set.
notes: direction, speedLeader, speed and altitudeDepth are now query params on 2D formats (commit 8ade39c). Remaining: default the 3D heading from direction.

title: Expose MIL-STD-2525D/APP-6 text amplifiers as query parameters
description:
A SIDC identifies what a symbol is; the 21 text amplifiers carry unit designation, strength, status, and reporting data. milsymbol 3.0 already implements all 21 as SymbolOptions, but the API exposes none of them.

Map query parameters onto the milsymbol options:
- Identity: uniqueDesignation, higherFormation, commonIdentifier, type, platformType, specialHeadquarters
- Strength/status: quantity, reinforcedReduced, combatEffectiveness, evaluationRating, signatureEquipment, equipmentTeardownTime
- Kinematics: direction, speed, altitudeDepth, location
- Reporting: dtg, staffComments, additionalInformation, iffSif, hostile

Measured coverage against milsymbol 3.0 (rendered output differs from bare symbol):
- Land unit (10031000141211000000): 21/21
- Land equipment (10031500001710000000): 20/21 (no reinforcedReduced)
- Air (10030100001101000000): 10/21
- Sea surface (10133000001207000000): 10/21

Inapplicable amplifiers must be ignored rather than error, since availability varies by symbol set.
acceptance_criteria: All 21 amplifiers settable via query string on the 2D formats; inapplicable amplifiers ignored without error; values are HTML/SVG-escaped.
close_reason: Route accepts XSIDC and all 21 amplifier query params on 2D formats; inapplicable ignored; milsymbol escapes text; verified live (commit 8ade39c).

title: Decide 3D export policy for text amplifiers
description:
The 3D pipeline (src/lib/symbol3d/build-scene.ts) extrudes SVG fill paths. Amplifier text is stroke-based and sits outside the affiliation frame, so it will not survive fill extrusion any better than the icon glyphs did (the reason frameOnly + bakeIcon exists).

Pick a policy per amplifier and document it:
- bake into the puck texture alongside the icon
- extrude as separate geometry
- omit from 3D exports entirely (likely default)

Depends on the amplifier parameters existing first.
